__reason: Every numeric column the migrations declare, classified once, by hand. `numeric(12,2)` is NOT a synonym for money: most of the columns below are quantities, rates, quota limits and confidences, and giving any of them a currency is the first failure mode of a search-and-replace through this schema (PLAN-multi-currency-20260828 §1.1). The list is pinned the way scripts/i18n-baseline.json is pinned — a numeric column that appears in a migration and in neither list fails check:currency, so the next money column cannot be added quietly. The inventory was verified against pg_attribute on a database that had replayed every migration: 79 parsed, 79 live.

__carriers.own: the table carries its own `currency` column — a document or transaction head, a price list row, or a threshold (plan §2)
__carriers.inherits:<table>: no column of its own; the currency is the parent row's. A document is never printed in two currencies (plan §2)
__carriers.allocation: no currency of its own by design; the composite foreign keys make a cross-currency link unrepresentable rather than merely rejected (plan §4.1)
__carriers.evidence: money, but a record of what a document or a model said — plan §3.3's protected class. It is read, never rewritten, so it gets no currency column and its currency is decided by whoever reads the interpretation that produced it

__assistantFactsNote: assistant_facts.value_numeric is money whenever its sibling `unit` column reads 'ils', and that check constraint (0164) accepts no other currency. The row is evidence of what the assistant cited in one run, so it is not rewritten — but the readers that PRODUCE it become currency-aware in phase 2, and the `unit` check must widen with them or a dollar figure will be stamped as shekels at the moment it is quoted. Recorded here because the plan never scoped the assistant, and a gap nobody wrote down is a gap nobody closes.

notMoney.organizations.vat_rate: a tax rate, not an amount
notMoney.invoice_lines.vat_rate: a tax rate, not an amount
notMoney.plan_entitlements.numeric_limit: a quota limit, counted in records or seats

__aggregatesReason: The 111 money aggregation sites that predate this work are rewritten in phase 2, not by this guard. From 0217 onward a new function that sums money and never says the word `currency` is the exact way the false total comes back, so it fails here.
